summary: Test-writing (red-phase) run for issue #5. Permanent unit tests for the generated OpenAPI client were added (9 tests + stubbed transport, no live server), and the full prose-contract-vs-published-spec delta analysis is recorded in docs/generated-openapi-client.md. The new tests intentionally fail to BUILD at this commit because the ColorMatchingOpenAPI generated module and OpenAPIRuntime dependency do not exist yet (missing behavior: the generated client itself, to be added in the implementation run). No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so swift test could not be executed locally; CI (macOS swift test) is the execution environment. Existing APIClientTests and MeasurementCoreTests are untouched and unaffected at this commit.

references.reason: Imports ColorMatchingOpenAPI + OpenAPIRuntime; module absent until implementation run adds swift-openapi-generator/swift-openapi-runtime and the vendored openapi.yaml per docs/generated-openapi-client.md 'Vendored document contract'.

Pre-existing app-surface tests (paths, snake_case payloads, bearer header) must keep passing after APIClient is rewired onto the generated client; they pass at this commit against the hand-written client.
Client-side-only models stay hand-written; MeasurementCore behavior tests unaffected.

StubbedTransport implements OpenAPIRuntime ClientTransport; all 9 generated-client tests run against local canned responses with no network. Cannot execute: no Swift toolchain in container and ColorMatchingOpenAPI module not generated yet.

15 verified contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the spec published by viamin/color_matching#110 (served at GET /api/v1/openapi.json; upstream SHA 47057afd58f7d46b4d4b740ca7d2d08947774471), plus an explicit endpoint-gap list. Inspectable; PR description compiles from it.

Exit criterion 'swift test green with generated types wired in' requires the implementation run (package wiring + vendored spec + rewired APIClient). CI on macOS runs swift test; new tests are the driver.
